newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka broker launches tea website.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka broker launches tea website.

text.p: One of Sri Lanka's longest-established tea brokers has launched an Internet website for the industry.

Forbes and Walker Tea Brokers (Pvt) Ltd said in a statement on Monday that traditional systems in the tea industry would be replaced by the website, where customers would have easy access to latest industry records and statistics.

"Instead of acknowledgements being posted, catalogues delivered, delivery instructions being conveyed through telephone and mail...all the customers need to do is log into "http://www.mega.lk/Forbes," the statement said.
It said data for buyers and sellers would be available.
"We are also giving selective access to people who deal through us," company director Anil Cooke told Reuters.
He said the company was well on its way to launching screen trading in tea locally, but did not say when that facility would be available.
